clips.title: The story
paras: Kormek's Hut is a remote, ramshackle dwelling sitting amid the barren flats of north-central Desolace. Despite its desolate surroundings and mysterious namesake, it currently shelters an eccentric pair: an oddly peaceful cultist and a goblin obsessed with harvesting kodo bones.

Perched out in the arid wastes of north-central Desolace, this small hovel is named after a figure whose whereabouts and identity remain completely unknown. Instead of Kormek, travelers stumbling upon the hut encounter an unusual pairing living out in the middle of nowhere: Willow and Bibbly F'utzbuckle. Inside the hut sits Willow, a member of the otherwise hostile and nihilistic Twilight's Hammer who curiously treats outsiders with calm hospitality. Outside, a pen littered with sun-bleached kodo bones serves as the personal dance floor and staging ground for Bibbly, an excitable goblin captivated by the commercial potential of bone scavenging.
